facts.anchor: She whirled but found herself dragged into the brush next to the path

facts.fact: 三个斗篷人从藏身处旁走过
facts.anchor: Three figures wearing voluminous cloaks that concealed their identities completely were passing their hiding spot.

facts.fact: 女巫们钻进山洞洞口藤蔓封合
facts.anchor: watched the group of witches duck into the cave
clenching her fingers around what she could feel now was some sort of medallion or locket on a long chain

facts.fact: 神秘人要求证明自己才给答案
facts.anchor: You wanted answers, Miss Halynar. They will be given in time, once you have proven yourselves.
